$comment: Downloadable sound packs (spec 12 §2.1 source 2, P6-R1; generated by scripts/sounds/curate-packs.ts from scripts/sounds/pack-sources.json — edit those, not this file). Same rules as processing/models.json: each pack names its upstream URL (never a mirror), the archive is pinned by sha256 and size, and every installed file by its own sha256 and size; the licence is on the AGENTS.md allowlist and `licenseEvidence` says where it was checked. Installed on request into <appdir>/sounds/packs/<id>/ by the engine's sound-pack-install job.
